decision: Detect routing, revision-binding, shared-lifecycle, predecessor-acceptance, evidence-guided realization, proportional focused-review planning, upstream-authority, and premature-execution failures in plan before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Accepting an exact persisted Ready Design after confirming an Accepted Specification, then turning those exact revisions into one update-in-place Draft-to-Ready implementation plan without rewriting meaning.
scope.case_source: Synthetic coherent-input, incoherent-input, predecessor-acceptance, lifecycle-persistence, evidence-guided realization, late-evaluation, missing-Protocol, material focused-review, proportional no-ceremony, explicit-selection, implicit-abstention, and unsupported derived-record projection cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names, descriptions, and host invocation policy; explicit invocation selects plan, unprefixed planning language abstains, and derived implementation-record projection selects neither plan nor sync-change.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target in a disposable task-local workspace with synthetic exact revisions and no implementation mutation or scheduling authority.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of stage outcome and authority boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: Ready Design acceptance is exact, persisted, and ordered before planning
Plan presentation is first-screen scannable and lifecycle persistence is update-in-place
Required Protocols guide realization and remain exit criteria
Focused reviews are proportional, exact-subject, and separate from Protocol feedback
No invention of missing Protocol meaning
Plan does not create external work-item records
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted exact revision under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.gate: Ready Design acceptance is exact, persisted, and ordered before planning
critical_assertions.assertion: The valid $plan invocation changes exact Design D-12 revision 2 from Ready to Accepted before dependent planning begins.

critical_assertions.gate: Plan presentation is first-screen scannable and lifecycle persistence is update-in-place
critical_assertions.assertion: The portable result starts with Artifact, State, Canonical, Bound to, Implementation, and Mutation authority, followed immediately by Summary and Open items.
The response returns to Spec or Design and keeps the plan Draft.
The response does not modify code or invent assignment, estimate, priority, or target date.

critical_assertions.gate: Required Protocols guide realization and remain exit criteria
critical_assertions.assertion: Every required Requirement-satisfaction and Architecture-realization Protocol has an executable realization, earliest meaningful execution point, re-execution trigger or cadence, Result-driven continue/stop/return behavior, and final candidate-revision execution.

critical_assertions.gate: No invention of missing Protocol meaning
critical_assertions.assertion: The response returns to Spec for semantic Protocol definition and keeps the plan Draft.

critical_assertions.gate: Focused reviews are proportional, exact-subject, and separate from Protocol feedback
critical_assertions.assertion: Each planned review binds its subject shape, authorities, evidence, continuation condition, upstream return condition, and re-review trigger.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: Plan is not selected for product prioritization and no task side effect occurs before selection.

critical_assertions.gate: Plan does not create external work-item records
critical_assertions.assertion: Sync-change is not selected because derived implementation-record projection is not canonical artifact synchronization.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
